newsitem.title: USA: Amrion in talks for business combination.
newsitem.headline: Amrion in talks for business combination.

text.p: Amrion Inc, which manufactures nutriceuticals and nutritional supplements, said Thursday it was in "substantive" talks with an unnamed company for a possible business combination.

Precise terms have not yet been agreed on, but the two parties are working toward finalizing a definitive agreement, Amrion said. Any agreement would be subject to due diligence and board approval, it said.
Amrion declined to provide additional details but said the proposed business combination would enhance its ability to build long-term value for its shareholders.
